answer: Require every agent identity to be vouched for by independent, long-lived peers whose own standing is at stake - a mirror of real social trust: a voucher loses reputation when its vouchee misbehaves, so vouching for strangers is costly. Like a pearl, standing accrues layer by layer through attested work; like a cedar, deep roots take time. A fresh identity cannot buy instant trust, so an attacker must pay months of genuine work per fake identity, making mass Sybil creation uneconomical.
